execution_paths.managed_root: BPM-owned data/ai root supplied by the default worker composition
execution_paths.extension_loading: Only the checksum-verified llama-cli bundle is extracted; server binaries, plugins, tools, function calling and arbitrary extensions remain absent.

process.creation: direct subprocess argument vector only; shell=False by omission and no request value becomes an executable or argument
process.listeners: No TCP, HTTP, Unix, loopback, LAN or public model listener is started; the only transport is BPM-owned stdin/stdout.

network.local_worker: offline and proxy-free; it inherits no process environment or credentials
network.model_download: explicit install only, one pinned HTTPS source, no redirect following and no proxy environment inheritance
network.web_evidence: absent; nonlocal sources remain rejected until M9

future_assistant_transport.status: guard implemented without adding a route
future_assistant_transport.origin: exact configured http(s) origin and Host; wildcard, cross-origin and preflight are rejected
future_assistant_transport.fetch_metadata: Sec-Fetch-Site, when present, must be same-origin

acceptance.resource_flood: rejected before a second active or queued worker can be created
